messages:
carla: Heads-up — running a POC with Broadway Systems. They forward logs+traces via Fluentd on Windows and hit intermittent 429s. Also their trace ids don't appear in Console search. Can we swarm? cc @evan @sam

ev an: Quick question: are they sending multiple log events per HTTP request or one-per-request? 429s often happen when big batched payloads exceed per-request limits.

carla: They batch ~200 events per chunk by default. Payload example they pasted: 

{
  "events": [{"msg": "order placed", "trace_id": "tx-77"}, {"msg": "payment processed", "trace_id": "tx-77"}]
}

sam: Two actionables to unblock quickly: 1) reduce buffer chunk size (chunk_limit_size or batch_size) so each HTTP request < 512KB; 2) add client-side backoff on 429s and obey Retry-After header.

nisha: For trace propagation: our Console picks up X-Request-Id or W3C traceparent. Fluentd needs header mapping. Example fluent snippet to inject header: 

``
<request_headers>
  X-Request-Id: ${record["trace_id"]}
</request_headers>
```

carla: They showed their out_http config; they do not yet map headers. I'll paste what I have: 

``
<match app.logs>
  @type http
  endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest/logs
  serializer json
  <buffer>
    @type memory
    chunk_limit_size 4m
    flush_interval 10s
  </buffer>
</match>
```

sam: chunk_limit_size 4m is probably the issue. Recommend 256k-512k for POC. Also new advice: set `flush_interval` lower (2-5s) to avoid big spikes.

ev an: If they cannot change the agent immediately, suggest a tiny HTTP proxy that: reads body, extracts trace_id, and adds X-Request-Id header before forwarding. That buys time.

observability-bot: Created a trace search link: Console > Traces q=x-request-id:tx-77 -> https://console.redwood.ai/traces?q=x-request-id:tx-77

nisha: Also check that their API key isn't on trial daily cap; trial keys can show soft rate-limits. Ben in billing can approve a temporary higher-limit test key.

carla: I'll relay: reduce chunk_size, add header mapping or proxy, implement backoff. Also will request a test key from sales. Thanks all. :pray:

sam: If after these changes trace ids still missing, have them capture raw request from Fluentd (curl equivalent) and paste it here so we can confirm header presence.

carla: Will do. I'll update when Broad way tests.
